description.value: Wild Waterways Adventures (WWA) is an Indigenous-owned, female-led wildlife tour company headquartered on Quadra Island, operating in the biologically rich Discovery Islands marine ecosystem of British Columbia. The company offers small-group experiences including grizzly and black bear tours, whale watching, old-growth forest hikes, kayaking, and wildlife photography workshops, all guided through a coastal, culturally informed lens with a commitment to carbon-neutral operations. Touring cyclists passing through Campbell River or Quadra Island can access a wide range of half-day and full-day adventures into some of the most spectacular wilderness on the BC coast.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Wild Waterways Adventures is an actively operating tourism company offering wildlife and kayaking tours from Quadra Island and Campbell River, with 2026 promotions listed and a contact page showing phone 250-201-5496. No OSM tags are present beyond the name and URL, so all amenity fields rely solely on website content, which contains no mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or any cycling-related amenities. The coordinates (50.033, -125.243) are consistent with the Quadra Island / Campbell River area described on the website.
